methods.comparison: Exact earlier raw-context and paragraph selection rules, without refitting on practical notices.
methods.docx: Serialize each case as DOCX body paragraphs, two runs per paragraph, then use the app extraction path and require identical Unicode source anchors.
methods.metric: Both flagged human views and useful generated-span location at character IoU at least 0.30.
methods.prep: Actual EOS and existing v273 word bounds, single block, copy and source-binding checks. Fixed complete sentence-prefix recovery for length or wrapper issues. No choice by classifier output.
methods.scope: One procedural paragraph rewrite attempt for each admitted source and licensed family. Offline MLX with affine 4-bit groups of 64.

preflight_correction.reason: Use the app’s canonical hash of the source map instead of reading a digest not stored on the extraction metadata. This correction preceded all generator and classifier loads.

privacy: Only agency and notice metadata, code/file commitments and aggregate outcomes. No case texts, generated paragraphs, DOCX files or private filesystem paths.

policy.controls: Use distinct donor blocks from the same federal notice. Whole paragraph and two adjacent interior sentence substitutions each preserve exact original flanks. Donors match 75–125% of the replaced word count.
policy.excerpt: Four or five source-order contiguous eligible body paragraphs totaling 210–620 words. The chosen interior target must be 55–135 words and have four or more complete sentences.
policy.roster: Fixed four daily issues and 27 preclassified agency-authored notice IDs. Retain one per issuing department or independent agency after rights, source, controls and fragment screening. Rank by SHA-256 of fixed salt and document ID, up to eleven.
policy.scope: Prose paragraphs from the issuing agency’s supplementary information. Exclude contact information, private quotes, footnotes, non-prose, and headings; remove only formatting whitespace.
policy.separation: Exclude any 12-token overlap with known project exposure or a different admitted agency. Pretraining exposure unknown.
